➢ Challenges associated with centralized storage
Ability of extension: As storage demand
increases, scaling centralized storage systems
becomes difficult due to space and hardware
resource limitations.
Efficiency: Data access performance decreases
when many users access simultaneously, leading
to bottlenecks.
Manage: Managing and maintaining large
storage systems is labor intensive and costly, and
increases the risk of data loss due to hardware or
software failures.

Part 7: Cloud Data Storage
❖ Cloud Storage
➢ The emergence and development of cloud storage
Cloud storage emerged in the late 2000s, when services like
Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, and Microsoft Azure
Blob Storage began offering online data storage solutions.
The development of cloud technology and the need for large
data storage have promoted the birth and rapid development
of cloud storage.
Part 7: Cloud Data Storage
✓ Ability of extension
✓ Access anytime, anywhere
✓ Cost savings

➢ Benefits of cloud storage

Part 7: Cloud Data Storage
❖ Cloud Storage
➢ Cloud Storage Architecture
• Components of cloud storage architecture - Storage Servers
✓ Roles and functions:
• The storage server is the core component of the
cloud storage system, responsible for storing
data and processing access requests from users.
• They are often designed with large capacity and
high performance to meet the needs of
continuous data storage and retrieval.
Part 7: Cloud Data Storag
❖ Cloud Storage
➢ Cloud Storage Architecture (CSA)
▪ Components of CSA - Data Transfer Network
✓ Roles and functions:
• A data transmission network is a connection system
between users and storage servers, ensuring data is
transferred quickly and safely.
• They provide high bandwidth and low latency to
optimize data access performance.
Part 7: Cloud Data Storage
❖ Cloud Storage
➢ Cloud Storage Architecture (CSA)
• Components of CSA - Management Services
✓ Roles and functions:
✓ Managed services are tools and software that
support the management and monitoring of
storage operations in the cloud.
✓ They provide functions such as resource
management, performance monitoring, and
problem alerts.
Part 7: Cloud Data Storage
❖ Cloud Storage
➢ Cloud Storage Works
• Data upload process
✓ Users upload data to the cloud storage
system via the user interface
✓ Data is distributed and backed up on multiple
servers to ensure availability and security
✓ Users access data from anywhere with an Internet
connection through a cloud interface
Part 7: Cloud Data Storage
✓ Store data without a defined structure, such as text
documents, images, videos, and other large data files.
Unlike structured data such as relational databases,
unstructured data does not have a fixed format.
✓ Application: Unstructured storage is suitable for storing
large and diverse data from many different sources, such
as data from social networks, email, and IoT sensors.
❖ Cloud Storage
➢ Modern Trends - Unstructured Storage
Part 7: Cloud Data Storage
✓ Stores data as objects, each object includes data, metadata,
and a unique ID.
✓ Benefit:
✓ Flexible scalability: Easily expand storage space by adding
new objects.
✓ Low cost: Object storage typically costs less than other
storage methods.
✓ Efficient data management capabilities: Metadata allows
data to be searched and managed effectively.
❖ Cloud Storage
➢ Modern Trends - Object Storage
Part 7: Cloud Data Storage
✓ SDS is a storage method that decouples the storage
hardware from the storage management software,
allowing for completely software management of
storage.
❖ Cloud Storage
➢ Modern Trends - Software-Defined Storage (SDS)
Part 7: Cloud Data Storage
✓ Combination of cloud storage and on-premises storage:
• Hybrid storage combines the advantages of both
cloud and on-premises storage, helping businesses
optimize costs, performance, and security.
• Businesses can store important and sensitive data
on-premises to ensure security, while storing less
important data in the cloud to reduce costs.
❖ Cloud Storage
➢ Modern Trends - Hybrid Storage
Part 7: Cloud Data Storage
✓ Application:
• Hybrid hosting is suitable for businesses
that need to balance performance, cost,
and security, such as financial, healthcare,
and government institutions.
❖ Cloud Storage
➢ Modern Trends - Hybrid Storage
